narrative.overview: Domovid borrows the care and material credibility of an architect's model table while keeping professional CAD complexity out of the customer's path. The house model is the primary evidence; typography and calculations explain its consequences.
keyCharacteristics: One active decision group at a time
One source for model, quantities and price
Clear assumptions instead of decorative CAD chrome

rules.name: The Scarce Terracotta Rule
rules.body: Terracotta identifies action or consequence and should not become general decoration.

rules.name: The Plain Language Rule
rules.body: A customer-facing label uses household language before construction terminology.

rules.name: The Model Earns Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to the primary model surface, not every container.
